text.EN: Just doing what had to be done.
text.TL: Ginawa ko lang kung ano ang kailangang gawin.

text.EN: Anyone else would have done the same.
text.TL: Kahit sino gagawin din ang ganoon.

text.EN: Just doing my part to keep us alive.
text.TL: Tungkulin ko lang para mapanatili tayong buhay.

text.EN: Glad I could pull it off.
text.TL: Mabuti at nagawa ko nang maayos.

text.EN: It was what the situation called for.
text.TL: Iyon ang hiningi ng sitwasyon.

text.EN: No big deal. Just handling business.
text.TL: Wala 'yon. Ginagawa lang ang trabaho.

text.EN: Happy to help. We are in this together.
text.TL: Masayang tumulong. Magkasama tayo rito.

text.EN: Just glad it worked out in the end.
text.TL: Mabuti na lang at naging maayos ang kinahinatnan.

text.EN: I did what I could. Thanks for noticing.
text.TL: Ginawa ko ang kaya ko. Salamat sa pagpansin.

text.EN: All part of surviving another day.
text.TL: Parte lang 'yan ng pagsisikap na mabuhay pa ng isang araw.

text.EN: Good. I was hoping you noticed.
text.TL: Mabuti. Umasa nga akong mapapansin mo.

text.EN: Glad to know the effort did not go overlooked.
text.TL: Mabuti at hindi nawalang-bisa ang pagod ko.

text.EN: It feels good to have that acknowledged.
text.TL: Masarap sa pakiramdam na kinikilala 'yon.

text.EN: I put sweat into that. Glad you caught it.
text.TL: Pinagpawisan ko 'yon. Mabuti at nakita mo.

text.EN: Thanks. It means a lot that you saw the work.
text.TL: Salamat. Malaking bagay na nakita mo ang pinaghirapan ko.

text.EN: Nice to have your approval on that.
text.TL: Mabuting makuha ang pagsang-ayon mo roon.

text.EN: I wanted to make sure it was done right.
text.TL: Gusto kong matiyak na tama ang pagkakagawa.

text.EN: Thanks. Recognition goes a long way.
text.TL: Salamat. Malaking pampalakas ng loob ang pagkilala.

text.EN: Glad my efforts are paying off for us.
text.TL: Mabuti at nagbubunga ang pagod ko para sa atin.

text.EN: Good to hear. I will keep at it.
text.TL: Magandang marinig. Ipagpapatuloy ko 'yan.

text.EN: That is nice to hear from you.
text.TL: Masarap marinig 'yan galing sa 'yo.

text.EN: Thank you. Coming from you, that carries weight.
text.TL: Salamat. Dahil galing sa 'yo, may bigat 'yan.

text.EN: I respect your opinion, so thanks.
text.TL: Iginagalang ko ang opinyon mo, kaya salamat.

text.EN: That gives me a solid boost. Thank you.
text.TL: Nakapagbigay 'yan ng lakas sa akin. Salamat.

text.EN: I appreciate hearing that today.
text.TL: Salamat at narinig ko 'yan ngayong araw.

text.EN: Always good to know where I stand with you.
text.TL: Laging magandang malaman kung ano ang tingin mo sa akin.

text.EN: Thanks. That takes some of the strain off.
text.TL: Salamat. Nabawasan ang pagod ko riyan.

text.EN: I am grateful for the praise.
text.TL: Nagpapasalamat ako sa papuri.

text.EN: Thank you. It is encouraging.
text.TL: Salamat. Nakakapagpalakas ng loob.

text.EN: Much appreciated. Let us keep winning.
text.TL: Maraming salamat. Tuloy lang tayo sa tagumpay.
